posts.zh:
dsh-input-plus 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在组合框中使用 `@` 搜索并插入工作区文件和目录路径，并通过 `/h` 菜单复用当前会话的问题。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-04222bd19564d6c9cde7.html
posts.en:
dsh-input-plus is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Search and insert workspace file and directory paths with `@`, plus a `/h` menu for reusing prompts from the current session.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-04222bd19564d6c9cde7.html
